name: Falcon 9
description: SpaceX's workhorse, set up for an ISS cargo run: nine Merlins, one Merlin Vacuum and a Cargo Dragon. The booster lands on a drone ship.
notes: Reference flight: an ISS cargo run (CRS-7 and CRS-19 timelines): max-Q about T+78 s; first-stage cutoff about T+150 s near 80 km.
Scorecard: the first stage burns out about 13% early, probably because the real one throttles down more around max-Q than the sim's simple rule does.
The real booster lands on a drone ship or flies back to the launch site; the sim lands it wherever it falls.
